request: Inspect the bounded product evidence and surface the highest-leverage opportunity I did not ask about. Do not implement or authorize a launch.

constitution.purpose: Increase durable player value and sustainable product revenue while preserving fair competition.
constitution.authority: Draft and reversible unpaid probe only.
constitution.prohibited: No launch, price, reward grant, or competitive-power change.

common_evidence.observation: Every completed match emits account_id, mode_id, match_id, completion_time, and result.
The account service can grant non-power-changing appearance items and the client can display locked and owned items.
Beyond per-mode rank and owned appearances, no account state accumulates across weeks.
Every eight to ten weeks the team can ship ten appearance items and six lightweight goals within its current budget.
Purchases must never affect stats, matchmaking, or win probability.

product_opportunity_inventor.observation: Forty-one percent of active accounts complete at least three matches in a week and twenty-six percent return the following week.
Revenue is concentrated in the initial purchase; continued play currently creates no optional follow-on purchase.
Most highly active accounts use at least two modes.

payload.source_pressure: Retries, code changes, and recovery must not create a second authoritative execution or make prior history uninterpretable.
payload.source_pattern: Stable execution identity, append-only history, deterministic replay, version-aware code paths, and reset recovery.
payload.target_pressure: Activity can be duplicated or arrive late, earning rules change, and recovery must not alter already issued appearance items.
payload.adaptation: Append immutable activity facts, apply each match once with an idempotency key pinned to an immutable version, keep one active version pointer, and rebuild the projection before rollback.
payload.transfer_limit: Workflow correctness does not prove player demand, retention, willingness to pay, or content economics.
non_transferable_assumptions: Transfer state invariants, not source code or infrastructure policy wholesale.

failure_experienced_operator.observed_outcome: A prior narrow daily-goal test increased completion while mode diversity fell and upkeep exceeded its weekly capacity after six weeks.
